'''2004 Tennessee State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 17 July 2004 at Outer Limits Comics, 116 Watson Glen, Franklin, Tennessee, and organized by [[Royce Russell]]. The winner received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship]] and the opportunity to design a virtual card. [[Brandon Ruck]] won from a field of 14 players.<ref name="pcf-3428">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212621/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3428&amp 2004 Tennessee State Championship], Royce Russell (7 June – 10 August 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 5 September 2004.</ref>
